title: Four slow days in Lisbon with a two-year-old
prompt: Four days in Lisbon with a two-year-old, staying in Alfama, slow pace.
note: The four days sit in a two-by-two grid of cards so a parent sees the whole trip at once and each card has the same rhythm, with the nap window as a tinted block between the outings because for this family the nap is the fixed point every day is built around. A warm paper ground, a four-cell glance strip, and a stroller-and-hills logistics band up front, since the hill is the thing that decides which days get the stroller; the rain plan and the cost note share a row so neither reads as an afterthought.
